purpose: the unit's suite: the pinned presentation end to end, the six-year arithmetic, the failure and ambiguity paths, the refusal paths and the state model

subject.specimen_path_policy: read from the path recorded by PROD-003's register; no path and no identifier is copied into this package

synthetic_fixture_note: every fixture is generated by this order for test input, carries a synthetic marker, and is never presentation evidence

tests.test: A1 admission of the pinned specimen passes every predicate
A2 the request date is the printed header value on every page
A3 the Collections section resolves to the pages that carry record rows
A4 both collection records are contract debt records with distinct boundaries
A5 each record binds its own printed Last Payment Date with a precise locator
tests.detail: record 1 page 16 line 32; record 2 page 17 line 5

tests.test: A6 the pinned specimen reproduces the arithmetic PROD-003 recorded
tests.detail: 1,919 days against a 2,191-day span -> PERIOD_NOT_EXCEEDED on both records

tests.test: A7 no state carries between runs and identical inputs reproduce identical results
A8 the evaluation reads no clock
tests.detail: the result is byte-identical while the clock is stubbed

tests.test: A9 the result carries the preserved classification and authorizes no finding
B1 before, at and after the sixth anniversary
tests.detail: 2027-01-31 not exceeded; 2027-02-01 not exceeded at the boundary; 2027-02-02 exceeded

tests.test: B2 a 29 February start clamps to 28 February in a non-leap sixth year
tests.detail: 2020-02-29 -> 2026-02-28; the days before, at and after behave as the boundary rule records

tests.test: B3 the six-year span is computed, not hard-coded at 2,191 days
tests.detail: one leap day 2,191; two leap days 2192; each span is derived from its own dates

tests.test: B4 a last payment after the report reference date is unresolved, never a negative period
B5 a reference date beyond the run clock is still evaluated as a pure function
tests.detail: a future reference date changes nothing about how the comparison is computed

tests.test: C1 a printed label with no value is unresolved, never absent
C2 a record that does not print the label is unresolved, never absent
C3 a malformed request date leaves the reference date unresolved
C4 contradictory request dates across pages are rejected
C5 an impossible calendar date is unresolved in both facts
tests.detail: an impossible reference date and an impossible printed payment date are both unresolved

tests.test: C6 a header label missing from some pages is unresolved
C7 a missing Collections heading is unresolved, never an absence
C8 a resolved section with no collection record is a demonstrable absence
D1 a field label printed outside any record is never read
D2 a region that is not the contract debt record is never read
tests.detail: NOT_A_DEBT_RECORD — the region does not print: Member Number, First Delinquency, Account Number, Balance

tests.test: D3 multiple records do not contaminate one another
tests.detail: record 1 resolved 2021/02/01; record 2 unresolved with no borrowed value

tests.test: D4 a Last Payment Date printed in another section is never used
tests.detail: the account-page date is not read for a Collections fact

tests.test: D5 a record-shaped label after the section is a continuity gap, not a silent truncation
E1 a fixture masquerading as a report is refused, not evaluated
E2 a PR-01-shaped document that is not the evidenced specimen is refused
tests.detail: one specimen does not establish support for every report from that bureau

tests.test: E3 a page with no native text is refused as a presentation, not read as empty
E4 a document that is not the contract geometry is refused
E5 a container that is not a PDF is refused
E6 an unreadable document is a document-level extraction failure, never an absence
E7 a synthetic model can never enter the evaluation path
tests.detail: both directions of the synthetic boundary are refused

tests.test: E8 a synthetic test-input result is stamped as not presentation evidence
tests.detail: synthetic test input: this result is arithmetic and locator evidence only and is never presentation evidence for a report

tests.test: F1 the five fact statuses are five distinct states
F2 no recorded refusal reason ever produces ABSENT_FROM_REPORT
tests.detail: 7 refusal reasons, none of them absence

tests.test: F3 a status and its value agree in every fact of the pinned run
F4 no comparison runs while either fact is unresolved
F5 the outcomes are exactly the three internal results and never a finding class
F6 the selection must be explicit, authorized and enumerated
tests.detail: authorized CA/CA-NS only; CA/CA-ON and an absent selection are refused
